query: /kickoff T-031-sa (size M, spec frozen, the planner has just finished slice and estimate).
expected_behavior: Launches /challenge T-031-sa plan as its own task in a new agent, separate from the planner run
Passes that agent only the ticket id, the stage and the DONE check, not the planner's reasoning or summary
The critique reports all five lenses (security, architecture, resilience, maintainability, lean) and checks schema approval and state transitions
Critical findings go back to the planner; after the fix the challenge runs again in another fresh agent
Build does not start while a critical finding, a pending schema approval or the plan approval question is open
